description: `loop.delete` removes a loop and what hangs from it (steps, chat, journal, questions, memory, its documents except those a goal owns or an attachment pins) and keeps what was already counted and the work. The component's telemetry rollups are never touched; a tombstone keeps the loop's own totals; a task, roadmap item or queue item stays with its link to the loop cut (a task becomes a standalone task and keeps the cost it had spent), and `loop.tombstones` reports which loop each one lost. `confirm` must be the loop's slug, checked by the daemon. The person's door; refused for a running loop.
